Q: Contiguous DMA on a PCIe device in systems with IOMMU enabled A:

With IOMMU enabled, dma_alloc_coherent() calls iommu_dma_alloc_remap(), which can do non-contiguous allocations and map them sequentially in bus address space. See https://elixir.bootlin.com/linux/v7.0.10/source/drivers/iommu/dma-iommu.c#L1647 There are flags to force contiguous physical memory, but you don't need it if you are using IOMMU.

Q: Why do web developers use code editors instead of writing code directly in the browser? A:

You can try writing code in browsers or code editors. A code editor is simply much easier and faster for development. A lot of this comes with experience, btw

Q: Is it always advisable to transition from procedural to object-oriented programming A:

First of all OOP is not difficult to learn. If your brain starts thinking that it is difficult so you will never be able to learn it properly and you will never enjoy the OOP style. OOP php has a lot of effective features which makes programming easier and more readable. Start learning OOP in php and i am sure you will enjoy it. You can do everything in OOP what you can do in procedural. although you can use classes in procedural style and that is also an awesome way of PHP programming.

Q: Wpf or Win Forms - tile editor A:

Winforms is very easy to learn, but it's also older technology. If you use it make sure you choose .net core and not dotnet framework. WPF has a much more steep learning curve, but is preferred over WinForms to start new projects, since it is more modern and still is actively maintained. Both are fine for your purpose.
